description: Votes for your own listing in the last `hours` hours, oldest first: vote id, in-game name, time (unix seconds) and whether your plugin has claimed the reward. Pass the answer's next_after as `after` to get the next page. Needs your listing's API key.

after.description: Only votes with a higher id than this (paging).

server.description: Optional. Your listing's id or slug. Defaults to the listing the API key belongs to; any other listing is refused.
